-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.InvPbCore` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem pbMsg_ufWire (T : Type) [PbGoType T] (l : Loc) (uf : List w8) : pbMsg T l uf ⊢ ⌜ufWire
    (pbSchemaOf (PbGoType.goTy T)) uf⌝

theorem pbMsg_persistent (T : Type) [PbGoType T] (l : Loc) (uf : List w8) : Persistent (pbMsg T l
    uf)

def pbN : Namespace :=
  nroot.@"protobuf"

def pbMsg (T : Type) [PbGoType T] (l : Loc) (uf : List w8) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(inv pbN
        iprop(∃ st sc us,
            typedPointsto (structFieldRef T go!"state" l) st (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              typedPointsto (structFieldRef T go!"sizeCache" l) sc
                  (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                typedPointsto
                    (structFieldRef T
                      go!"unknownFields" l)
                    us (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                  ownSlice us uf (DFrac.own 1)) ∗
      ⌜ufWire (pbSchemaOf (PbGoType.goTy T)) uf⌝)

theorem pbMsg_alloc [package_sem : Assumptions] (T : Type) [PbGoType T] (l : Loc) (st :
    google_golang_org.protobuf.internal.impl.MessageState) (sc : w32) (us : GoSlice) (uf : List w8)
    (E : CoPset) (huf : ufWire (pbSchemaOf (PbGoType.goTy T)) uf) : typedPointsto (structFieldRef T
    go!"state" l) st (DFrac.own 1) ∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef T go!"sizeCache" l) sc (DFrac.own
    1) ∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef T go!"unknownFields" l) us (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ownSlice us uf
    (DFrac.own 1) ⊢ |={E}=> pbMsg T l uf
